result:
I’d make the long-term consequences of our actions feel as real to us as the short-term ones.

If people could vividly understand—emotionally, not just intellectually—how their choices would affect others years later, especially people with less power, I think a lot of cruelty, greed, and negligence would become much harder to justify.
